title: Arkret MLS Governance Read
description: Near-current stateless group_security_frontier query and outcome only. Bulk/history recovery replays the retained accepted Seal cut through standard Event/Seal resolve and is not a proof profile. complete_control_state_v1, epoch-range activation proofs, opaque nodes, full-object embedding and shared proof dictionaries are forbidden.

proof_request_common.description: The exact RFC 8785 canonical request must not exceed 8 MiB. This aggregate bound includes local_mls_leaves and is enforced after Schema validation and before materialization.

local_mls_leaves.description: Exact occupied public RFC 9420 leaves from the caller's locally verified current or pending group state, in strictly increasing leaf_index order. The service rejects duplicate leaf_index or credential_ref and proves governance state against this every-and-only set; the receiver repeats the comparison against its own group state. This is query input and is never copied into the response.

proof_base_basis.description: Canonical complete verified accepted base antichain. The caller MUST also hold the crash-safe local predecessor joined verification checkpoint for this exact basis; the wire field is not a standalone trust source.

proof_target_basis.description: Canonical complete accepted target antichain. It dominates proof_base_basis: every base leaf is retained or is an ancestor of a target leaf. The service never substitutes a single arbitrary head.

byte_limit.description: Caller-selected canonical response-byte ceiling for one complete near-current frontier selector. The response must fit without truncation or cursor. If the exact base-to-target frontier projection cannot fit, the caller must obtain a closer independently verified basis or fail closed; it cannot split cells or accept a partial frontier.

base_group_state_ref.description: Required only for a successor transition and byte-identical to the already accepted winning Genesis/Commit Event for previous_epoch. It never names the transition being authored. Genesis (0 -> 0) has no prior MLS group-state Event, so this field is forbidden there; this avoids an EventId/governance-binding authoring cycle.

leaf_canonical_preimage_b64u.description: Unpadded base64url of the exact leaf_data bytes. For state_root this is RFC 8785 JCS UTF-8 of {cell,state:{value}}. For control_event_set_root this is the raw digest bytes obtained by decoding the selected Event digest suite prefix.

leaf_digest.description: H(0x00 || decoded leaf_canonical_preimage_b64u) under the digest suite named by root_digest.

merkle_membership_witness.description: Closed RFC 6962 membership witness. The verifier resolves root_seal_ref, requires its signed root_field to equal root_digest, independently reconstructs the domain-specific canonical leaf bytes, requires leaf_index < leaf_count and consumes exactly the audit-path length implied by leaf_count. Siblings are ordered from the leaf level upward.

value_digest.description: Digest of the exact resolved cell value reconstructed from the content-addressed provenance Events; full value bytes are not embedded in the page.

provenance_event_refs.description: Canonical complete FSM/join-chain Event references. Their signed bytes are resolved outside the page and must match proof_material descriptors.

event_ids.description: Canonical every-and-only Event ids named by sparse frontier provenance entries and boundaries. Each id losslessly binds its suite-bearing full digest. This array is not a duplicate catalog of every Seal.delta Event in the base-to-target cut; those exact accepted Event selectors come from each resolved signed Seal.delta and are fetched separately for checkpoint replay.

seal_predecessor_edges.description: Canonical UTF-8 ordering by (seal_ref,predecessor_seal_ref). It contains every and only direct predecessor edge needed to verify the anchor-to-target closure, every activation cause and every predecessor root named by a first-coverage witness.

typed_proof_material.description: Complete every-and-only content-addressed selector set for one near-current stateless group_security_frontier response. seal_descriptors are canonical by seal_ref bytes, event_ids is the direct canonical EventId set, and predecessor edges are canonical by their tuple bytes; duplicates are forbidden. Sparse paths live only in typed witnesses. Full signed proof objects are resolved through standard Event/Seal resolve; each Event's recomputed digest must equal the suite and full digest losslessly encoded by event_id. Complete checkpoint replay additionally resolves the exact Event digest set signed in the resolved Seals' delta arrays; those Events are not duplicated into event_ids unless sparse provenance also names them.

frontier_range_witness.description: Included entries occupy every index in [start,end). Adjacent authenticated boundaries/state edges prove completeness, including an empty prefix.

state_root.description: The exact signed state_root of target_seal_ref. Every entry and boundary witness in this branch MUST use that same target Seal and root.

frontier_branch_projection.description: One independently signed target-branch projection. It never claims that a joined multi-leaf state root was signed by one Seal.

frontier_registry_digest.description: sha256(RFC 8785 JCS bytes of the exact mls-security-frontier-registry.json artifact used for this projection). The verifier compares it with its locally pinned artifact digest; the service cannot select registry semantics.

branches.description: Canonical UTF-8 order by target_seal_ref and every-and-only the query proof_target_basis leaves.

frontier_projection.description: Per-target-leaf signed projections. The verifier validates every branch independently, then uses complete accepted-Seal replay and the generated lattice registry to join the full target antichain before deriving one security_frontier_digest.

query_digest.description: SHA-256(UTF8('ak.mls-governance-proof-query-v1') || 0x00 || JCS(exact request)). The response does not repeat local_mls_leaves; the caller retains the request and requires this digest to match.

group_security_frontier_outcome.description: A deterministic, complete near-current response for the exact query_digest and its caller-retained group-binding selector and canonical base/target antichains. Bulk history authorization and activation are reconstructed by direct accepted-Seal traversal and are not fields or profiles of this response.
